user_story:
As a user, I want to be able to toggle checkboxes so that I can select my preferences. Acceptance criteria: 
1. The page should display the title 'The Internet'. 
2. The page should have headings containing 'Checkboxes'. 
3. There should be two checkboxes present on the page. 
4. The checkboxes should be of type 'input' with 'checkbox'. 
5. The URL should remain the same after interactions with the checkboxes.
